purpose: Fresh independent effect verification of generic YAML-to-JSON conversion with pinned Ubuntu yq.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'yq=3.1.0-3' >/dev/null
python - <<'PY'
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,re,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/bound_capabilities/yq_yaml_json.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('yq_verify',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=m; s.loader.exec_module(m)
src='.github/workflows/astra-shared-runtime.yml'
out='canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/YQ_WORKFLOW_VERIFY.json'
res=m.run({'yaml_path':src,'output_path':out},root)
data=json.loads((root/out).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
raw=(root/src).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert data['name']=='ASTRA Shared Runtime Mission'
assert re.search(r'(?m)^name:\s*ASTRA Shared Runtime Mission\s*$',raw)
jobs=data.get('jobs') or {}; assert jobs
for job_id in jobs:
 assert re.search(r'(?m)^  '+re.escape(job_id)+r':\s*$',raw),job_id
uses=[]
for job in jobs.values():
 for step in job.get('steps') or []:
  if isinstance(step,dict) and step.get('uses'): uses.append(str(step['uses']))
assert uses
for ref in uses:
 assert re.search(r'(?m)^\s*-?\s*uses:\s*'+re.escape(ref)+r'\s*$',raw),ref
assert 'workflow_dispatch' in (data.get('on') or {})
print(json.dumps({'adapter_result':res,'workflow_name':data['name'],'job_ids':sorted(jobs),'uses':uses,'raw_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),'independent_raw_support':True},sort_keys=True))
print('YQ_YAML_JSON_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED')
PY
